newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: YACHTING-RUDDER DAMAGE PUTS FRENCH YACHT OUT OF RACE.
newsitem.headline: YACHTING-RUDDER DAMAGE PUTS FRENCH YACHT OUT OF RACE.

text.p: French yachtswoman Isabelle Autissier sailed into Cape Town on Tuesday after being forced to withdraw from an around-the-world race by a broken rudder.
Autissier told reporters she would continue the race "in my mind" once a new rudder had been installed. According to the race rules, stopping at a port means automatic disqualification.
Autissier's yacht PRB lost one of its two rudders on Sunday when it was about 460 miles south-west of Cape Town. The yacht was among the front three racers at the time.
